stage0062_03:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text: ～ $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ Command Room ～

stage0062_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$大塚$$
「Well then, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$...
　do you have no memory either
　of the words 'the 12,000-year cycle'?」

stage0062_03:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I have heard it somewhere before...
　but I cannot recall it」

stage0062_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$セイミー$$
「So it's Geminis's memory manipulation, after all?」

stage0062_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$田中司令$$
「To meddle with $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s memory, an inorganic
　intelligence... Geminis's power is fearsome」

stage0062_03:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「With $$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$ closing in,
　these mysterious words from $$ゴードン・ローズウォーター$$...」

stage0062_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Given that $$グーラ$$ and $$アドヴェント$$ know of it too,
　it likely holds great significance going forward」

stage0062_03:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$大塚$$
「Please, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$...!
　no matter what, remember what that phrase means!」

stage0062_03:r_1d6bc48b7f246730.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I too understand the gravity of the matter」

stage0062_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Hey, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$, you crossed the dimensional wall
　to come to this world too, right?
　So can't you break the Prison of Time?」

stage0062_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Unfortunately, that is impossible.
　The current dimensional boundaries are tangled;
　my transfer ability alone cannot breach them」

stage0062_03:r_4d863c3fb88a4c39.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「The only weapon left to me now
　is my knowledge as guardian of the cosmos」

stage0062_03:r_44f4742c3dcce39a.text:
$$田中司令$$
「Having that sealed away is troublesome indeed」

stage0062_03:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「I intend to dive into my own depths
　to recover my sealed memories」

stage0062_03:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Got it, $$ＷＩＬＬ$$.
　In the meantime, we'll run $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$
　on the sub-system」

stage0062_03:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$セイミー$$
「It's fine.
　I've found someone who can pinch-hit
　for $$ＷＩＬＬ$$」

stage0062_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Rough around the edges, but the performance's solid」

stage0062_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「That helps, $$セイミー$$.
　...Very well, I'll try...」

stage0062_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「Speaking as a counselor,
　I think it's unlikely $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ will recover its memories」

stage0062_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$田中司令$$
「And why would that be?」

stage0062_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「$$ＷＩＬＬ$$ might not realize it,
　but it's afraid to recover its memories」

stage0062_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「In other words, it's $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ itself
　keeping the lid on those memories」

stage0062_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「So the fear alone makes diving pointless...」

stage0062_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$大塚$$
「But even $$ＷＩＬＬ$$, guardian of order
　between parallel universes, feels fear...」

stage0062_03:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$セイミー$$
「That 12,000-year cycle... what in the world is it...?」

stage0062_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Director $$大塚$$...
　I have one idea about the key to that mystery」

stage0062_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「To make contact with it,
　we will now head for 《$$新世界大陸$$》」

stage0062_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$大塚$$
「Our fate hangs by a thread.
　I'm counting on you to keep that flame alive, $c」

stage0062_03:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$$朔哉$$
「...So that's how we ended up going to see
　$$ロージェノム$$ at the $$新世界大陸$$」

stage0062_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$n
「The former Spiral King, now a biocomputer...
　can he be trusted?」

stage0062_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That man has changed.
　Not that it's my place to say, but for the better」

stage0062_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「We once feared the 《$$アンチスパイラル#keyword$$》
　and oppressed hairless monkeys, so-called humans,
　but now that strength is recognized」

stage0062_03:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「After trading blows with a former enemy,
　to finally acknowledge each other and join hands...
　now that's thrilling!」

stage0062_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「That's about the size of it」

stage0062_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$葵$$
「$$ロージェノム$$'s lived through such a long span
　of time, he might know about the 12,000-year cycle,
　or give advice on breaking the Prison of Time」

stage0062_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$くらら$$
「More than anything, meeting him face to face
　might jolt $$ＷＩＬＬ$$'s memory back」

stage0062_03:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「An odd pairing beyond human understanding」

stage0062_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$シモン$$
「I've already contacted $$ロシウ$$.
　Once we arrive, he'll set up a meeting
　between $$ロージェノム$$ and $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ right away」

stage0062_03:r_ce1b55e526b6277a.text:
$$キタン$$
「Hey, hey, $$シモン$$!
　There's someone you should've called
　before $$ロシウ$$, isn't there!」

stage0062_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$ダリー$$
「The Spiral King's daughter, and $$シモン$$'s girlfriend」

stage0062_03:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「She's a very lovely person.
　A bit... no, quite... actually, utterly ditzy though」

stage0062_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Basically, she and $$シモン$$ make a good match」

stage0062_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I see... so Mr. $$シモン$$ has someone like that too...」

stage0062_03:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$葵$$
（Miss $$スズネ$$...
　Ever since that date incident with $n
　and the nurse, she's been sensitive to that）

stage0062_03:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$ジョニー$$
（Well, Miss $$スズネ$$ is at that age, after all）

stage0062_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$キタン$$
「Honestly, $$シモン$$...
　are you still on the same level as $$ギミー$$?」

stage0062_03:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$キタン$$
「You're seeing your girlfriend after ages,
　so plan something, you know, an event or whatever!」

stage0062_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Cut it out, $$キタン$$.
　$$シモン$$'s got a surprise planned this time」

stage0062_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$朔哉$$
「A surprise from you is pointless, man...」

stage0062_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Wonderful, $$シモン$$!
　Could it be that ring you bought
　on your day off was for this!?」

stage0062_03:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「What's with that wishy-washy attitude?」

stage0062_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$シモン$$
「N-no...
　I'm resolved to do it, but...
　when it comes down to the moment...」

stage0062_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「What spineless nonsense is this!?
　Is that the leader of the Dai-Gurren Brigade!?」

stage0062_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Is that it!?
　Did leaving the $$新世界大陸$$ and learning
　to eat grass pull out your fangs!?」

stage0062_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「Ugh, pathetic, so pathetic!
　Talking big and tough all the time,
　only to chicken out when it counts...!」

stage0062_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「$$エイーダ$$'s got a point, too」

stage0062_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$くらら$$
「A proposal means so much
　to a girl, you know...」

stage0062_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ギミー$$
「Your face is bright red, $$くらら$$」

stage0062_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$n
「Not a scene you see every day」

stage0062_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I understand... I really do, $$くらら$$!
　It's every girl's dream event!」

stage0062_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$葵$$
「Let's leave those two and their weird excitement...」

stage0062_03:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$葵$$
「Think hard about where
　your drill is meant to head」

stage0062_03:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$葵$$
「You punched that $$アンチスパイラル#pilot$$
　and got back someone important, didn't you?」

stage0062_03:r_366814efdc8b5800.text:
$$葵$$
「Trust the person who believes in you」

stage0062_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$シモン$$
「...Thanks, $$葵$$.
　I... won't chicken out anymore」

stage0062_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「All that's left is heading for the $$新世界大陸$$」

stage0062_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$キタン$$
「T-this is huge news...!
　We've got to tell the Dai-Gurren Brigade too...!」

stage0062_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$n
「So there's no use
　in you panicking, $$キタン$$...」

stage0062_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$シモン$$
「Let me say it one more time.
　Thanks, $$葵$$」

stage0062_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$葵$$
「You're welcome.
　Not as much as $$くらら$$, but I guess
　I've got my own dreams too」

stage0062_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$シモン$$
「Come to think of it, this happened before too.
　Right after Bro died...」

stage0062_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$シモン$$
「$$葵$$ saved me that time too, huh...」

stage0062_03:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$葵$$
「Save that smile for $$ニア$$.
　Along with that ring you agonized over buying」

stage0062_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「This is a crisis on a global scale.
　And I believe the key to overcoming it
　lies with $c」

stage0062_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「I was able to change.
　Thanks to that person, and all of you」

stage0062_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$リーロン$$
「The problem is $$ロージェノム$$.
　As you can see, he's a difficult one」

stage0062_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$リーロン$$
「Of course, we've asked him plenty here too
　about $$エタニティ・フラット$$ and $$バアル$$, but he just clams up」

stage0062_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Even so, we have no choice but to bet on him and $$ＷＩＬＬ$$」

stage0062_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$リーロン$$
「Got it, $$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$.
　who knows, some unexpected chemistry might come of it」

stage0062_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「By the way, where's Mr. $$シモン$$?」

stage0062_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「He's apparently staking his life on a big gambit」

stage0062_03:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「No way... he's fighting $$バアル$$'s whole swarm alone!?」

stage0062_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$キノン$$
「He does seem to have that kind of resolve.」

stage0062_03:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$リーロン$$
「That's true.
　Though he's always been slow like that.」

stage0062_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「So does that mean it's already too late...!」

stage0062_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$リーロン$$
「Just leave it be, $$キノン$$.
　It's more fun to watch it like this.」

stage0062_03:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「No need to worry, $$ロシウ$$.
　$$シモン$$ is bound to come away with victory.」

stage0062_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Now then, $$ロージェノム$$...
　I'll transmit $$ＷＩＬＬ$$ here, the rest is yours.」

stage0062_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$リーロン$$
「I'll leave you two alone,
　so talk as frankly as you please.」

stage0062_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「But can humanity really accept that truth...?」

stage0062_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「It's been a while, $$ロージェノム$$.」

stage0062_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Not since the $$再世戦争$$, then.
　Though time means nothing to us anyway.」

stage0062_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「But that isn't true of organic life.
　Robbed of time, decline is all that awaits them.」

stage0062_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The Prison of Time, is it...」

stage0062_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Tell me, $$ロージェノム$$.
　What awaits this world's future?」

stage0062_03:r_3c5fcfc484a51913.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$, $$バアル$$...
　And the 12,000-year ring...
　What could they possibly mean?」

stage0062_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「You already know the answer to that.」

stage0062_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「You're what I was, back when I still kept
　humanity caged underground as the Spiral King.」

stage0062_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「It's not that you can't remember...
　It's that you don't want to.」

stage0062_03:r_9af213fc64e0afec.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「That's only natural.
　Spending it inside this Prison of Time would be
　happier for humanity, after all.」

stage0062_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Decline in the far future, or ruin tomorrow...
　Choosing the former would only be natural.」

stage0062_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「$$エタニティ・フラット$$ is a paradise sealed away...
　Or in other words, mercy.」

stage0062_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Once the door is opened, there's no going back.
　What waits is an endless war of gods and demons.」

stage0062_03:r_03b5db9ce98fb8d6.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「That's right.
　This planet stands at that doorway.」

stage0062_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The lid on your memories is starting to open...
　Then that reaction is only natural.」

stage0062_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「But there is one who won't allow that mercy.
　And it will soon awaken...」

stage0062_03:r_23a9c7ab620ab112.text:
$$ニア$$
「What's wrong, $$シモン$$?
　We finally made it back to $$カミナシティ$$,
　and you bring me out here...?」

stage0062_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$ニア$$
「Let's go see $$キヨウ$$.
　Little $$アンネ$$... she's grown so much.」

stage0062_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$シモン$$
（If $$エタニティ・フラット$$ is ever completed,
　$$アンネ$$ won't be able to grow up...）

stage0062_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$シモン$$
（It's not just $$アンネ$$...
　No child would grow up, and the babies still
　in the womb would never be born...）

stage0062_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$シモン$$
「...It's nothing.
　But my mind's made up now.」

stage0062_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$シモン$$
「I... I like the view of the city from here.
　That's why I wanted $$ニア$$ to come here with me.」

stage0062_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$ニア$$
「Is that so?
　Then we're the same, aren't we.」

stage0062_03:r_050d0532c4b24bfe.text:
$$シモン$$
「Everyone's living out there, laughing under the sun.」

stage0062_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$シモン$$
「That's why I want to protect this city...
　the world... and $$ニア$$, too.」

stage0062_03:r_d69dc027cba3003f.text:
$$シモン$$
「Not as a princess, or the Gurren Brigade,
　just seeing, hearing, and laughing the same.
　I want that with $$ニア$$, from now on.」

stage0062_03:r_3c3735172a480b72.text:
$$シモン$$
「My eyes could be $$ニア$$'s eyes, her ears mine...
　I thought something like that might be nice...」

stage0062_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$シモン$$
「I want you to... take this.」

stage0062_03:r_4fb296e63cb1fb46.text:
$$ニア$$
「Something must have come to $$カミナシティ$$...」

stage0062_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「For now, looks like things worked out.」

stage0062_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$ニア$$
「Thanks to $$シモン$$ and the others.」

stage0062_03:r_fae689f2a1057b61.text:
$$キヤル$$
「H-hold on a second, $$ニア$$!
　Don't act like nothing happened!」

stage0062_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「Did you really turn down $$シモン$$'s proposal!?」

stage0062_03:r_d441e6cc908ac01b.text:
$$ニア$$
「I just thought maybe we couldn't
　become the same person, the two of us...」

stage0062_03:r_d584d4b5af55b1cf.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「I mean, sure, that's true...
　that's just how married couples are, but...
　but that's just a figure of speech!」

stage0062_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「That $$シモン$$!
　The one who's only good for digging holes
　or piloting $$グレンラガン$$, finally said that!?」

stage0062_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「So what about that, huh!?
　What about your feelings!?」

stage0062_03:r_2b93cca10f1c36a8.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「That's right!
　What matters isn't the meaning of the words,
　it's what you feel in that moment!」

stage0062_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$キヤル$$
「Sounds like you've got your answer.」

stage0062_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「You're as unworldly as ever, aren't you.」

stage0062_03:r_a8118b2e37aa1382.text:
$$キヤル$$
「Well, that's just so like $$ニア$$, though!」

stage0062_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「Now it's the woman's turn!
　Show your feelings, not just words.」

stage0062_03:r_22c8caf8c08c5119.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「Looks like it'll work out somehow.」

stage0062_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$ニア$$
「Thanks to $$シモン$$ and the others.」

stage0062_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$キヤル$$
「H-hold on a second, $$ニア$$!
　Don't act like nothing happened!」

stage0062_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「Did you really turn down $$シモン$$'s proposal!?」

stage0062_03:r_ef7426919f628d8a.text:
$$ニア$$
「I just thought maybe we couldn't
　become the same person, the two of us...」

stage0062_03:r_fd6bdf7910d7d925.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「I mean, sure, that's true...
　that's just how married couples are, but...
　but that's just a figure of speech!」

stage0062_03:r_3fe2078328753c16.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「That $$シモン$$!
　The one who's only good for digging holes
　or piloting $$グレンラガン$$, finally said that!?」

stage0062_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「So what about that, huh!?
　What about your feelings!?」

stage0062_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「That's right!
　What matters isn't the meaning of the words,
　it's what you feel in that moment!」

stage0062_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:

「Sounds like you've got your answer.」

stage0062_03:r_fa59c6df081e6ae4.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「You're as unworldly as ever, aren't you.」

stage0062_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$キヤル$$
「Well, that's just so like $$ニア$$, though!」

stage0062_03:r_aa5d235c78ebe19f.text:
$$キヨウ$$
「Now it's the woman's turn!
　Show your feelings, not just words.」

stage0062_03:r_3036adce91d1f4a8.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Have you made up your mind?」

stage0062_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「My memory seal hasn't lifted yet,
　but I've resolved to move forward.」

stage0062_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Rather than sit and await a distant death,
　will you choose the path where faint hope remains...」

stage0062_03:r_c9016e3ab05470b0.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「$$ロージェノム$$...
　What about you?」

stage0062_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「My resolve was set long ago.
　And it seems the time to prepare has come.」

stage0062_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「So an inorganic intelligence can laugh.」

stage0062_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「This too is something they taught me.」

stage0062_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「But be on your guard.
　The turning stars call forth a star of ill omen.」

stage0062_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「It's Mycenae.
　I don't know the details, but they're moving.」

stage0062_03:r_414e6e90094d1413.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「The 12,000-year cycle...
　Even I don't know what that phrase means.」

stage0062_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「But the image it evokes
　is likely something we both share.」

stage0062_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Before the war of god and devil, none of this may matter...」

stage0062_03:r_cb6d9ee71c24b042.text:
$$ＷＩＬＬ$$
「Even so, let's move forward.
　Down the path of hope, however hard it is.」

stage0062_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Prepare Arc-Gurren for departure.」

stage0062_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「Is it finally on the move?」

stage0062_03:r_0835ec3fff318aff.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「...Unless the Prison of Time breaks, it's all for nothing.」

stage0062_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「But put another way,
　breaking the Prison of Time is when
　the true battle begins. We must prepare.」

stage0062_03:r_bc0273c6ae91c929.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Let's hope it turns out needless worry.」

stage0062_03:r_8deea7c70d7a76e7.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「Is it fine not to tell $c?」

stage0062_03:r_660c72e627d873c7.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「Telling them what lies beyond is pointless
　while they can't even clear the threat at hand.」

stage0062_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ロシウ$$
「Then we'll be the ones to prepare for that day.」

stage0062_03:r_6ccd85652ef4ccf1.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「To stop is despair, to advance is despair...
　But beyond the despair that lies ahead,
　what waits, once overcome, is hope...」

stage0062_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$ロージェノム$$
「I wonder if humanity can make it that far...」

stage0062_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Don't worry, $$ニア$$.
　We'll protect $$シモン$$.」

stage0062_03:r_6be0d6139fac197c.text:
$$ヴィラル$$
「Though I doubt he even needs
　that sort of thing anyway.」

stage0062_03:r_df899b8031b4ca06.text:
$$赤木$$
「A man with a place to come home to is strong.
　...Or so I heard from someone.」

stage0062_03:r_308e8ac66b1141ef.text:
$$キタン$$
「That's how it is, $$ニア$$.
　Sorry, but newlywed life'll have to wait a bit.」

stage0062_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「Though I don't plan to keep you waiting that long.」

stage0062_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ニア$$
「Understood.
　I'm counting on you for $$シモン$$... and the world.」

stage0062_03:r_9f7c18d1ea1b55c9.text:
$$ニア$$
「The ring I got in that battle before...
　and the one you gave me today...
　I'll treasure them both.」

stage0062_03:r_34a510533cb8a9f5.text:
$$弁慶$$
「How are $$渓$$ and the others doing?」

stage0062_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「$$真ゲッタードラゴン$$, huh...
　Recovery's done, but they say
　the Getter Furnace still won't ignite.」

stage0062_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$ダヤッカ$$
「According to $$號$$, it's not time yet.」

stage0062_03:r_32b2a8ce24deeb9f.text:
$$隼人$$
「If he says so, then that's how it is.」

stage0062_03:r_c7ef92060bb8199d.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Then, before that time comes,
　we'll clean out whoever's after the Earth.」

stage0062_03:r_1be6d12f616f04e4.text:
$$キタン$$
「Right on.
　For $$シモン$$ and $$ニア$$'s sake too.」

stage0062_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$ニア$$
「Everyone...
　If there's still time before you leave,
　please come to my house.」

stage0062_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$ニア$$
「Since you've come all the way to $$カミナ$$ City,
　please let me treat you to a meal.」

stage0062_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$ヨーコ$$
「I-I mean, thanks, but
　wouldn't $$シモン$$ and $$ニア$$ be better off,
　just the two of them?」

stage0062_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't worry about it, $$ヨーコ$$.
　Meals are more fun with everyone together.」

stage0062_03:r_13ce8d4e4858b193.text:
$$ノリコ$$
「Well, if that's the case, I guess
　I'll join in. ...Let's go, $n, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

stage0062_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$n
「Right...
　I'll take you up on that offer.」

stage0062_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$$シモン$$
「Don't hold back.
　Right, let's invite $$シンジ$$ and the others too.」

stage0062_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I'll be intruding, Mr. $$シモン$$, Miss $$ニア$$.」

stage0062_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$ニア$$
「I'll go all out and make a feast.」

stage0062_03:r_6cf1e5ed68d98bd4.text:
$$キタン$$
「This'll show you all once again
　how well $$シモン$$ and $$ニア$$ suit each other.」

stage0062_03:r_e62eb587b8d34cb9.text:
$$竜馬$$
（I'll have the stomach meds ready and waiting.）

stage0062_03:r_ecf4e1c8c0f8d2d7.text:
$$ニア$$
「Yes, $$シモン$$...
　We'll always be together like this, won't we.」

stage0062_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You did it, Master $$正太郎$$.
　Reconciling with Prince $$グーラ$$... a step forward!」

stage0062_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But in the end, $$グーラ$$ left anyway...」

stage0062_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That kind of tsundere,
　you need to hit hard, just once.」

stage0062_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$正太郎$$
「What's a tsundere...?
　Seems $$アスカ$$ gets called that sometimes...」

stage0062_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Definitions vary,
　but let me offer my own interpretation...」

stage0062_03:r_0cd6aab432ee5af7.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「It's the tundra zone and Adelaide within a person.」

stage0062_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Tundra's high latitude, north hemisphere.
　Adelaide's high latitude, south hemisphere...
　It spans the whole Earth, in other words.」

stage0062_03:r_b8902c992035da79.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「In short, it means your heart's that big.」

stage0062_03:r_9293c52555ba1457.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right.
　As expected of Master $$正太郎$$, quick on the uptake.」

stage0062_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Thanks, $$ＡＧ$$.
　I'll teach $$ワッ太$$ too.」

stage0062_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...What is this feeling of guilt...
　Ah... despite being a robot,
　I've gone and deceived Master $$正太郎$$...」

stage0062_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Still, today's shift in Prince $$グーラ$$'s heart
　is a huge win. It earned a 100Z Z-Chip, after all.」

stage0062_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Let's add this to the squad's stock.」

stage0062_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$アスカ$$
「You idiot robot!
　What did you teach $$正太郎$$, huh!?」

stage0062_03:r_fa09fad95980b867.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Sorry, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Asking you to pinch-hit for $$ＷＩＬＬ$$
　and control $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$.」

stage0062_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No, no...
　Glad my gray electronic brain could help.」

stage0062_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Being modest? You've got a cute side.」

stage0062_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「It's not really a thank-you, but
　please let me give you counseling.」

stage0062_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「You're a fully autonomous AI, after all.
　You must build up stress just like a human.」

stage0062_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$ルゥ$$
「That's why,
　please let me tend to your mind.」

stage0062_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$セイミー$$
「And leave your body maintenance to me!」

stage0062_03:r_c33c28fb471faf59.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Uh, I'll have to pass!
　My actual job keeps me busy!」

stage0062_03:r_b69df689192adfc2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Kind of you, but I...!
　Believe it or not, I'm delicate,
　and I don't like being touched!」

stage0062_03:r_8a9ac301023aa8d3.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Well then, I'll flee while... selling, selling!」

stage0062_03:r_4cab8ba7b88b6c2a.text:
$$セイミー$$
「Come on, come on!
　I'll strip you bare, mind and body!」
